idea-plugin.name: Japanese Naming Assist
idea-plugin.description:
Suggests English identifier names from a Japanese phrase typed in the Java editor. Type a Japanese phrase (e.g. 稼働時刻) where a name goes and pick an English candidate (operationTime). English input is left to the standard completion unchanged. Works offline with bundled dictionaries. To reorder, join or swap the words of a candidate, press Alt+Enter while the candidate list is shown. User dictionary: Settings | Tools | 日本語→英語 命名.
This package uses the JMdict/EDICT dictionary files (processed for naming). JMdict/EDICT (c) Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, CC BY-SA 4.0 (licence).
